title: Lifted and Padding Indices Are Distinct
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a literal on $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be one of three padding positions, and let $r$ be a sign. After lifting $L$ to $n+3$ coordinates, its index differs from the index of the padding literal at position $i$ with required sign $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A padding position in a set of three positions
